title: Renderer: linear and radial gradient fills
description: The Canvas 2D renderer at packages/authoring-ui/src/renderer.ts (or similar path) likely only supports solid fill colors. Add support for linear and radial gradient fills in ShapeDisplayObject. Check packages/core/src/engine/types.ts for the Fill type definition. Implement gradient rendering using CanvasGradient API. If Fill type doesn't yet support gradients, extend it. Test by adding a gradient shape to a fixture and verifying no crashes.
